stem: A particle of mass m moves on the x-axis according to the equation, x = 2 + 4 sin 4πt. Choose the INCORRECT option:

options.A: The particle is undergoing SHM with x = 2 as the mean position
options.B: The amplitude of its oscillations will be 4 units
options.C: The number of times the particle is at x = 0 in 1 second is 2.
options.D: The particle reaches x = 0 for the first time at t = $\frac{7}{24}$s.
